title: Collections
summary: Gather items to climb Hypixel's collection tiers. Each tier unlocks recipes (minions, enchanted items, gear) and gives SkyBlock XP.

s.x: Collections count how much of each item you have gathered. There are

of them, the same as on Hypixel SkyBlock: 25 Mining, 20 Farming, 15 Foraging, 12 Fishing and 11 Combat. Each has its own tiers (from 5 up to 12) with Hypixel's amounts, and each tier unlocks what it does on Hypixel.
Open the SkyBlock Menu and choose
Collections
to see your tiers.
A collection counts items you
gather
Items you pick up from the ground, mine, harvest, chop or fish.
What you collect from your
minions
(Collect All, taking items out of their storage, or picking the minion up).
Items you buy, craft or get from another player don't count. A collection counts its own item only: an Enchanted Cobblestone is not 160 Cobblestone for your collection.
The Mushroom collection counts both Red and Brown Mushrooms.
Every tier lists its rewards, as on Hypixel:
Recipes.
Most tiers unlock something in the
Recipe Book
: the collection's minion, its enchanted forms, minion upgrades, gear. Until you reach the tier, the recipe is locked.
SkyBlock XP
: 4 per tier.
Some tiers list skill experience ("+1,000 Mining Experience").
When you reach a tier you get a notice, a sound and the list of rewards in chat.
Collections are kept per
profile
. The Rift's collections come with the Rift.
